Laura / team,

Quick note to keep momentum on the renewal. After our internal alignment, attached is a compact proposal that balances price stability with the capacity flexibility you've asked for. High level: 

- 12-month price hold on current list rates for model family A (applies to committed tokens).
- Convertible retainer: up to 30% of committed spend may be held as retainer credits that automatically convert to committed capacity if usage trend > 110% for two consecutive months.
- Surge buffer (temporary burst pool): 25% of committed capacity available monthly before true-up at a capped overage rate.
- True-up mechanics: monthly reconciliation; overage credits applied first against retainer balance.

Attachments: NP_Renewal_Summary_v2.pdf (one-page summary) and a short SLA appendix. Key asks from us: a 12-month renewal signature and a PO referencing deal ID NP-2026-042.

If this looks directionally right I can loop in Legal/Finance and send a term sheet for signature. Would you be available for a 30-min call Wed or Thu to walk through the convert-to-retainer flow?

Priya —

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifying items on our side before we escalate to Finance: 

1) Can you confirm whether the price hold applies to both hosted and dedicated deployments? We run a mix and need parity.
2) Convertible retainer sounds useful but we need an explicit floor/ceiling on conversion triggers and clear reporting so our billing team can reconcile automatically.
3) Procurement asked whether the surge buffer overage rate can be capped at a fixed premium (e.g., +20% over list) rather than variable.

Procurement would also like to see an explicit clause stating how unused retainer credits are handled at contract end (rollover vs. forfeiture). Finally — we prefer a 60-day SLA review window tied to the term; can that be incorporated in the appendix?

We are preparing a draft PO but want the term-sheet language nailed down first. I can do a call on Thu 08 Apr at 11:00 PT if that works for you.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Cloud Ops | Northpoint AI

Team — quick internal read. I think we can make the commercial concessions Laura asked for while protecting unit economics. Recommend the following counters to include in NP_TermSheet_v3: 

- Price hold to cover both hosted and dedicated variants for 12 months (explicit call out).
- Overage cap: fixed premium of +20% over list for any usage above surge buffer.
- Convertible retainer triggers: conversion occurs when monthly usage > 110% of committed for 2 consecutive months AND cumulative overage in the trailing 3 months > 150% of committed. This prevents frequent flip-flopping.
- Rollover: unused retainer credits can be rolled forward one quarter only; remaining balance forfeited at contract termination unless otherwise agreed.
- Reporting: we will provide a monthly consumption CSV and an aggregated 30-day reconciliation report; legal to add a clause requiring automated invoice-level detail.

Also propose a modest concession on price: 10% discount on the committed volume in year 1 (applies to committed token pricing) in exchange for a signed 12-month PO within 14 days of the term sheet. This helps close and keeps revenue predictable. Ops: Markus, can you confirm the feasibility of automated reconciliations and the new reporting cadence? Marissa — please prep a slim legal term sheet (NP_TermSheet_v3.pdf) with those bullets.

Thanks,
David
SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference
